title: Garnish's Personal GUI
description: Simple tweaks to the hotbar, experience bars, hearts, and more!
body:
This is a resource pack that's mainly for UI textures, although there's a bit more to it than that, the main purpose to it is to make the main hotbar area more appealing, at least for me personally.

A full list of everything in this resource pack is as follows:

. Hearts (Animal, hardcore, and normal) all have been changed, as well as their effected variants (IE, if you're chilled, you get blue hearts, and if you're withered, you get black hearts)

. Armor was made to look diagonal rather than straight

. Hunger was adapted, so that it no longer looked like you were just eating the bone or something

. The bubbles were changed so that they were more transparent

. The hotbar was changed so that it was cleaner and had a gray transparency rather than a green rough one

. The hotbar selector and offhand for left and right have been cleaned up as well ad made purple

. The experience bar has a green background, and a purple highlight that shows up when you have experience

. Jump bars for mobs have also been changed

. This is fully compatible with older versions to my knowledge!! Definitely compatible with 1.20.4+, but also I added extra textures meaning it'll have something to pull from in the older versions!!


Please keep in mind that some textures didn't exist back then, for example there was no "flashing absorption heart" in the old files, so that's a perk of using modern Minecraft.

And the final thing is

. I have also changed the main menu panorama to be the trial chambers panorama from 1.21, as I missed and love the asthetic for it personally.

Please note that "default" in this context does not mean "untextured," it should mean "these are the hearts you start with no matter what, they're a fallback heart when you don't have any effects." I just used "default" for short. Thank you.
